notes.title: Release Today! Into The Darkness VR Early Access
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The day we've all been waiting for is finally here – Into The Darkness VR will be available later today in Early Access on PCVR via Steam!

So, what can you expect from the current version of the game?
At launch, Into The Darkness VR features the first half of the story campaign, with the remaining levels already deep in development. In addition to the Story Mode, Early Access includes a fully playable Sandbox Mode with multiple unique rooms and physics-based mechanics. You’ll be able to freely experiment using the Spawn Gun to create your own scenarios with weapons, enemies, and objects – and yes, we plan to keep expanding this mode over time.

We're also planning to add an Arcade Mode featuring fun mini-games like snowball fights and our own twist on the classic CoD Zombies formula – perfect for quick sessions and replayability!
We’re not sticking to strict development phases or dates – many features are already far along in production, and we’ll be adding them as soon as they’re ready.

So, what’s next? Here’s a quick look at what we’ve got planned:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/8d38854d92b0142200ca8436717d4fd1f89e4774.jpg

Into The Darkness VR is an ambitious, physics-driven VR game that blends a gripping story campaign with deep sandbox possibilities – all built for PCVR. Early Access gives us the opportunity to polish the experience with your input, and we believe the best ideas come once players get their hands on the game.

So dive in, explore, and don’t hesitate to share your feedback, ideas, or bug reports. Help us shape this world – together.

Known issues:

 pause menu does not work on controllers other than Meta Quest (we are still working on support for less popular headsets)
 in rare cases the game may crash while loading a checkpoint
 some settings may not apply correctly or have no effect at this stage.
 putting random items into quickslots can cause that quickslot to stop working

Troubleshooting:
Click here to visit our Steam forum thread, where we explain how to fix issues like black screen, missing hands, startup problems, and performance drops.

Thank you for being with us,
9 lives & Cosmos Games teams

notes.title: Development Update - Into The Darkness VR
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Welcome to another devlog! Today, we'll give you a quick update on the progress of Into the Darkness VR. Each of the team members is in the process of developing their big components and it's hard to show anything specific at the moment. We understand that the technical details of rebuilding the Unreal Engine to extract more performance may not be interesting (so we will not bore you with that), but we want to assure you that we're making every effort to create a game that uses the full potential of PCVR.

We've recorded a sneak peek of one of the game's rifles in action. The gif showcases the seamless reloading feature, where the magazine can be ejected and replaced with a smooth motion. Additionally, we've added more physical elements to the game by making each bullet a separate object that can land on your weapon. While we understand your eagerness to see gameplay footage, we're excited to share it with you soon. Keep an eye out as we gear up for the early access release of Into the Darkness VR in 2023.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/579d99b071b86017a8404c3cbd628e948a020fc7.gif

If you want to be even closer to the development process - you are more than welcome to join our Discord server and ask us any questions!

Gameboom VR & Cosmos Games teams

notes.title: Release Date Update Into The Darkness VR
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

New release date

Time for another devlog! Today’s topic is the release date. The significant expansion of the project means that we are unable to release the game in 2022. We already have many finished elements, some need polishing, and some are in the process of development (for example, we are in contact with voice actors).

We also want you to understand what we are working on. Into The Darkness VR will offer a deep story. We want every character in the game to have an interesting personality and to tell their part of this complex story. We are also working on scenes that (we hope) will ensure that you will not forget about the game for a long time.

We have big plans for Into The Darkness VR, and just like you, can’t wait for the game. We know that these types of complex story-driven VR games do not come out too often, so everything has to be perfect. We hope you can play Into The Darkness VR in 2023.

In the meantime, we leave you with some new work-in-progress screenshots from the engine.

notes.title: Development update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Thank you for waiting patiently for Into The Darkness VR! We've been a bit quiet since we released the gameplay demo, but we want to reassure you that development is progressing.

https://media2.giphy.com/media/Kunn03Vxh9ifEPLod9/giphy.gif?cid=790b761135006505b695173c050402bdcf8cc33ae520745c&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g

What's happening with Into The Darkness VR right now? 

A lot has changed in the game since Cosmos Games started developing Into The Darkness VR. However, in addition to the game itself - the VR games market has changed as well. Currently, you can see a certain division into games exclusive to PCVR and those that are also aimed at Meta Quest.

Nowadays, VR games are mostly planned to run natively on Meta Quest headsets, which imposes some limitations. While we don’t reject the idea of bringing the game to Quest - we decided that we would like to make a full-fledged VR title that maximizes the potential of PC VR. Therefore, we expanded the scope of Into The Darkness VR and significantly expanded the story of the game.

https://media2.giphy.com/media/eC1H8PajvH8JkUwRZd/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611692120997c4dc91f1a83c0900074eb8c591da9d8&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g


Feedback from the demo

It was a great idea to publish the gameplay demo. The players on our Discord have given us so much feedback, that we are still implementing ideas and suggestions. Although Into The Darkness VR is a project of a small Cosmos Games studio, many of you thought that it was dealing with an AAA production. You don't even know how it made us happy!

The expectations are high and we don't want to disappoint you. Therefore, GameBoom VR, which until now was only a publisher, joined the production process. Cosmos Games is working on gameplay and GameBoom VR is responsible for the design. We believe that together we will provide you with a fantastic game.

https://media4.giphy.com/media/Vwuf8mpAHOSs8cjpTI/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611c9d1263ff21cee9858689d2779d1b956e7f668e4&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g

What have we changed?

While we don't want to reveal all the changes we're making to the game just yet, we've decided to reveal a sneak peek of what we're working on.

The locations that we showed you in the demo and on the videos are just a small fragment of what is being prepared. You can expect a greater variety of stages and not always just going from A to B. More complicated missions, more diverse scenery etc.

https://media2.giphy.com/media/cRxvPtEqdu1fP7WBR3/giphy.gif?cid=790b761139127d05f26a367a6e4ef204d95733c5725bc41b&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g

There will also be new gameplay mechanics. We are testing new gadgets that you will be able to use during the game, because in Into The Darkness VR, combat will not have to be a solution in some cases. We check completely new things and analyze their impact on the gameplay.

https://media2.giphy.com/media/MZFSEepsOHwFOVmB4e/giphy.gif?cid=790b761117718ad438ba91217bbdb7b428e950b5e61299fc&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g

It's worth adding that you haven't seen all the opponents in the game yet, and we are planning several types of robots with different behaviors. If you're gamers who like to shoot, we also have good news that the arsenal in the game will be quite large...

As for the story, dialogues, voices, pace of the game, tutorials - we carefully analyzed the players' needs and watched probably all the gameplay videos on YouTube to see "how you play". We change the position and behavior of opponents. We develop the functionality of the base. Basically, during regular meetings, we wonder how to surprise you at every level of the game.

New release year

Of course, we are also working on fixes, support for certain VR headset models, and many other things. Yes, we have a lot of work to do. But preparing Into The Darkness VR for such a community is pure fun.

The changes we are introducing, expanding the scope of the game... as you probably guessed, all this takes a long time and Into The Darkness VR will not debut in 2021. As such, we announce that the new release year is 2022. We promise that we will inform you regularly about changes in the game.

If you want to be even closer to the development process - join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/dERxD78

New demo coming next year!

Into The Darkness VR changed as a result of the feedback we received from you being able to play the demo. We appreciate your opinion and we want to continue this way of communication with you.

That's why we announce that in early 2022 there will be another version of the Into The Darkness VR demo, which will include the changes we've been working on over the past months. We are not hiding anything - you will be able to check the game for free and tell us what you think.

Cosmos Games and GameBoom VR Teams

HD version of published videos and screenshots available to download here.

notes.title: Another demo update (0.6.0) is live! WMR support, QUEST + VD instructions
notes.notes:
Hi there,

thanks for the continuous feedback. We are working hard to fix all the issues and make sure that everyone will be able to try the demo! We are still have issues with WMR bindings, we will provide the devs with proper device and try to fix the issue as soon as possible.
Here is the changelog:

 fixed hand position after melee weapon break
 disabled elevator collision channel for auto crouching
 optimized player pose for lower crouching
 add versioning text ingame for feedback purposes
 fixed a bug where player cannot continue after shoot all the bullet in Shooting Range Tutorial level
 optimized hand size
 auto update height when player is using controller to move
 updated UI distance to camera
 disabled UI appear at item when grab


To play the game via Oculus Quest + Virtual Desktop make sure that SteamVR is closed and run the game through Oculus Dash in headset.

Best,
Mateusz | Gameboom VR

 First mission

More info about these gamemodes in the previous announcement: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1529530/view/5582755747660675816

More info about the upcoming full release:
In the full version of Into The Darkness, players will receive even more additional game modes that are still being developed. We can already reveal that the sandbox mode will definitely appear, allowing you to play freely with weapons.

notes.title: Demo update is live!
notes.notes:
Hi there,

thanks for all the valuable feedback! We know that your expectations are high and we will work hard on the game to meet them. Keep in mind that this is not AAA title, but a game made by small indie dev studio. Regardless of that we will do our best to up the quality in all departments in coming months.
We addressed most of the issues that were possible to fix in short time. If you encountered any issues in previous version, we recommend starting New Game. Here is the full changelog of the new update:

 fixed bug in tutorial level where player finish shooting and cannot continue,
 fixed bug in Warehouse where scanner next to the big door that lead to the ending of level,
 small climbing optimisation,
 player height optimisation so player can crouch and grab object on floor,
 minimum player height set to 120,
 fix vive controller input binding,
 changes in save architecture to boost performance in some areas (it’s better to start New Game and delete old saves),
 fixed grammar in dialogues,
 add more sound effects.




The issue with HP Reverb and Quest + Virtual Desktop is still not solved, but we are working on it. If it’s not solved until the end of Steam Next Fest, we will make the demo available longer than planned, so all of you have the opportunity to play the game.


Best,
Mateusz | Gameboom VR
